rotation: Given the high severity of persistent inflation and monetary policy tightening, sectors likely to benefit include utilities and consumer staples, which tend to perform well in higher interest rate environments. Conversely, technology and real estate sectors may face pressure due to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer spending power.
